blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Filipino motorists will need to pay more for gasoline products this week, as oil firms plan to raise prices by about P3 per liter beginning Tuesday. The Department of Energy (DOE) said Monday that gasoline prices will go up by as much as P3.50 per liter. READ: Gasoline prices set to rise next week Diesel and kerosene, meanwhile, will have price cuts of at least P1 to P1.90 per liter, respectively.
